maddeler.e:
أستنطق (form X)
# أَسْتَنْطِقُ (ʔastanṭiqu) /ʔas.tan.tˤi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# أُسْتَنْطَقُ (ʔustanṭaqu) /ʔus.tan.tˤa.qu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# أَسْتَنْطِقَ (ʔastanṭiqa) /ʔas.tan.tˤi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# أُسْتَنْطَق
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
